name: Cube with an Antipodal Pair Deleted
definition: For each $n\geq2$, remove the all-zero and all-one vertices from the displayed $n$-cube.
properties: Its ordering width and cube-completion width both equal one. Every proper coordinate support is shattered, but the class has $2^n-2$ concepts and therefore is non-ample. Together with its complementary antipodal pair, it gives cube-completion widths $1$ and $n-1$, an unbounded complement asymmetry.
